results.summary: Harvey W James presents this luxurious 1 Bedroom 1 Bathroom Apartment, located on the first floor of the prestigious White City Living development. Step into a world of opulence and sophistication as you enter this stunning living space, designed with the highest standards of modern living. This exclusive apartment is adorned with contemporary finishes and stylish furnishings, creating an elegant ambience that exudes luxury. The open-plan living area is bathed in natural light, with large windows providing breathtaking views of the surrounding city. Step outside to your own private balcony and revel in the awe-inspiring vistas of the north facing skyline. The perfect spot for relaxation or entertaining, this private outdoor oasis is a true haven for urban living. As a resident of White City Living, indulge in the ultimate luxurious lifestyle with access to a range of exceptional leisure facilities. Stay in shape at the fully-equipped gym, unwind in the swimming pool or detox in the sauna, all included in your rent. You'll feel pampered and rejuvenated every day. With no parking included, this property is perfect for those who prefer to travel in style. Convenient public transport options are located nearby, making it easy to access the best of London's shopping, dining, and entertainment scene. Experience the epitome of modern luxury living at White City Living. This is your chance to live like a celebrity in one of London's most sought-after developments. Don't miss out on this extraordinary opportunity to live in unparalleled comfort and style. The Property Built 2025 Sqm2: 51 Westmont Apartments 1st Floor Lift Access: Yes Furnished - Designer Furniture Private Balcony Secure Entry Systems 24hr Concierge North Facing Leisure Facilities High-speed 1GB enabled HyperOptic broadband available (subject to connection) Estimated Decoration Condition/Age: 1-2 Years - Light Wear No Parking Room Information Living Room / Kitchen – Measurements: 6.59 x 3.34 m (21'7" x 10'11") – A bright and contemporary open-plan living space featuring floor-to-ceiling windows and direct access to a private balcony. The room is furnished with a two-seater sofa, accent chair, coffee table, and a TV stand, all in a modern, neutral palette. A dining table with four upholstered chairs sits under a stylish pendant light, creating a welcoming spot for meals or entertaining. Bespoke built-in shelving with integrated lighting offers extra storage and a convenient workstation area. The kitchen is finished in a sleek gloss grey and white color scheme, complemented by white composite worktops and matching upstands for a seamless look. The cabinetry is handleless, providing a clean, minimalist aesthetic. High-quality Siemens appliances include a double oven (with the upper oven also serving as a combination microwave), a 4-zone induction hob, an integrated fridge freezer, and a fully integrated dishwasher. A stainless-steel undermount sink with a chrome mixer tap is set into the countertop, and the overhead cabinetry incorporates concealed LED lighting for both task and ambient illumination. The entire space is finished with engineered wood flooring, enhancing the modern feel while ensuring easy maintenance. Balcony – Measurements: 1.59 x 3.81 m (5'2" x 12'6") – A private covered outdoor space featuring composite decked flooring and a secure metal balustrade. This generous area comfortably accommodates a small table and chairs, making it ideal for al fresco dining or relaxation. Overlooking the landscaped communal gardens with partial views of Westfield London, the balcony provides a pleasant extension to the main living space. Bedroom – Measurements: 3.01 x 2.78 m (9'10" x 9'1") – A stylishly furnished double bedroom featuring a plush upholstered blue headboard that serves as a striking focal point. The bed comes with a high-quality mattress, and each side is flanked by a contemporary bedside table complete with matching lamps. A large floor-to-ceiling window provides abundant natural light and is fitted with roller blinds for privacy. The room is finished with a soft, neutral-toned carpet, adding warmth and comfort underfoot. Located adjacent to the hallway’s built-in wardrobe area, this bedroom also enjoys convenient access to the bathroom, making it a functional and relaxing retreat. Bathroom – Measurements: 2.17 x 1.50 m (7'1" x 4'11") – A meticulously designed space showcasing large-format stone-effect porcelain tiles throughout, complemented by a white textured tile detail within the shower/bath area. The full-size bath is fitted with a brushed copper overhead shower and hand shower, all enclosed by a frameless glass screen for a sleek, modern look. A floating vanity with an integrated rectangular basin is paired with a brushed copper tap, while the mirrored cabinet above features integrated LED lighting and concealed shelving. Subtle recessed LED strip lighting around the bath panel and in the built-in shelf niches provides ambient illumination. Completing the space is a brushed copper heated towel rail and a concealed cistern WC with a soft-close seat, adding both convenience and elegance. Hallway – Measurements: 4.70 x 1.24 m (15'5" x 4'1") – A bright entrance corridor finished with engineered wood flooring and neutral décor. Fitted with full-height storage cupboards that provide ample space for coats and personal items. This hallway leads directly to Bedroom 1 and the adjacent bathroom, ensuring a practical flow throughout the apartment. One section of the hallway houses built-in wardrobes (with hinged doors, hanging rail, and integrated shelving), offering additional storage conveniently located just before entering the bathroom. Leisure Westfield, White City - The famous shopping destination boasts a variety of powerhouse designers, international brands and anchor stores. If you work up an appetite from all the shopping, Westfield offers around 50 different eateries, ranging from casual on-the-go food spots to sit-down venues Shepherd’s Bush Market (0.2 miles) - Located on the east side of the railway viaduct for the Hammersmith and City Tube line is Shepherd’s Bush Market. One of London’s most famous markets, the buzzing shopping site has been operating in the city for over 100 years, making it a key attraction in the West London community Bush Hall (0.4 miles) Bush Hall is an independent live music and events venue with a vibrant history. Over the years, the W12 venue has been used as a dancehall in the roaring 20s, a soup kitchen during World War II, and a rehearsal venue for stars such as Cliff Richard and The Who Linford Christie Stadium (1.5 miles) The venue was renamed after sprinter Linford Christie the year after he won the Olympic 100m gold. The Jamaican-born British former sprinter grew up near Shepherd’s Bush and won gold at the Olympics Transport White City Underground Station – 0.1 miles (Central Line) London Buses routes 72, 95, 220, 228, 272 and 283 serve the station directly. White City bus station is a few minutes walk south of the station. Wood Lane Underground Station - 0.1 miles (Hammersmith & City and Circle Lines). Shepherd's Bush Station - 0.7 miles (Central Line, London Overground). Heathrow Airport - 30 minutes via Heathrow Express from Paddington station Cost and Fees Move-in cost – Traditional Method: £2,700.00 (Rent in advance) + £3,115.38 (5 Weeks Security Deposit) = £5,815.38 (Total move-in cost) Move-in cost – Reposit No Deposit Method: £2,700.00 (Rent in advance) + £623.07 (1 Week) = £3,323.07 (Total move-in cost) Council Tax – Hammersmith and Fulham: E - £1773.95 - This may be exempt if all parties are students or a discount is applied accordingly. The property is ideally located close to the open spaces of Holland Park & Shepherds Bush Green; ideal for outdoor pursuits. Westfield shopping centre is within walking distance and offers a range of amenities that includes a cinema, designer shops, eateries and children's play activities. Other nearby amenities include a selection of theatres, lively bars, nightclubs, restaurants and cafes. results.summary: This very stylish 2 double bedroom apartment set in White City Living is situated within the heart of Shepherds Bush. The property enjoys easy access to a number of transport stations, with Wood Lane, White City & Shepherds Bush Underground, Overground & Train Stations being close by (Central, Circle, District, Hammersmith & City Lines, Overground & Southern Trains). There are also plenty of local buses available in the area. Central garden view and set on the 3rd floor spans 940 Sq Ft internally, this impeccable apartment is offered on a furnished basis and has been stylishly decorated throughout with contemporary furnishings. It comprises a large open plan double reception room with dining space and sizable floor-to-ceiling windows affording lots of natural daylight into the property. There's a spacious fully fitted modern kitchen with breakfast bar and well-known built-in appliances, master bedroom with a built-in wardrobe, luxurious en-suite double walk-in shower, 2nd double bedroom with built-in storage spaces, spacious further luxurious 2nd en-suite shower room, internal storage room, utility room, guest cloakroom/WC and a sizable private balcony (63.5 Sq Ft Additionally). The property further benefits include air cooling, underfloor heating, air ventilation system, iDevice controllable home automation system, double glazed windows, hardwood floors in the reception room, luxury comfort carpet in the bedroom, storage room and a good size utility room. The residents also freely enjoy from 24 hours security, concierge, CCTV, lift access, resident's lounge, meeting room, reading area, beautiful swimming pool, spa, top-end fully-equipped onsite gym facility, communal gardens and high-spec cineplex (personal Blu-ray disc on demand & PS4 Pro available). The property is ideally located close to the open spaces of Holland Park & Shepherds Bush Green; ideal for outdoor pursuits. Westfield shopping centre is within walking distance and offers a range of amenities that includes a cinema, designer shops, eateries and children's play activities. Other nearby amenities include a selection of theatres, lively bars, nightclubs, restaurants and cafes.
